item.title: Maharashtra politics after Ajit Pawar: Sunetra Pawar set to lead NCP, to take oath as Maharashtra Dy CM today

item.title: Q3 results: Airtel, Suzlon, SBI, LIC, IOC, VBL, RVNL to post earnings next week; check date
item.description: Mid-week on Wednesday, February 4, focus would be on Tata Group’s retail powerhouse, Trent and utility major Tata Power. The Bajaj Group would also report its earnings, with Bajaj Finserv and Bajaj Holdings declaring numbers.

item.title: 'Not even aware if it is happening': Sharad Pawar's first reaction on Sunetra Pawar's oath-taking
item.description: The Rajya Sabha MP will replace her late husband in the cabinet and will continue to hold the Excise and Sports ministries in the state government.

item.title: Inside BJP’s ‘audition’ strategy: Why poll duty could decide careers under Nitin Nabin?
item.description: Party insiders describe it as an informal “audition” process, where performance in upcoming Assembly elections could determine who finds a place in the organisational team of newly appointed BJP president Nitin Nabin.

item.title: Silver tumbles 30% below $80 after worst-ever sell-off triggered by liquidity wipeout
item.description: Silver price today: Silver’s parabolic rally ended in a violent crash on Friday, with prices plunging up to 30% in what traders called a historic liquidity wipeout. The sell-off came just a day after the metal hit record highs across global and domestic markets. A Fed-driven macro shock, overbought technicals and forced liquidation amplified the fall.
